steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Where did that blue-haired kid go?

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: She couldn't have gone far with those injuries! Root her out! How dare she think about snatching ${PlayerName} from right under our noses!
The two gangsters run off into the distance. Cloaked in shadows, Crache hides in mid-air and catches her breath. She's injured.
The situation is even worse than she had imagined. Though she had singlehandedly beaten a big group of Yagyu Executives before, it's a totally different story to fight a bunch of Sinners.
What's more, these Sinners have split into several factions, all attacking each other.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Should I call them Sinners... or monsters...
She grits her teeth as she treats her wound. She starts moving through the shadows, wondering what's going on.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Without a doubt, all of this is caused by Mania. Those hyperactive "Sinners" aren't just going wild from gaining a new power. The power itself is the problem.

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: This is similar to what happened to Hella and Hecate. Their minds are a lot more chaotic than before, but I don't seem to be affected at all...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Ha... There are more Sinners here today than all the Sinners that appeared in DisCity in the past ten years...

Guess it's really the "shackles'" fault... I'm not shackled, so I'm not affected. But the folks from the MBCC, as well as those who came to get the "shackles" on their own, are having problems. Those from the MBCC are seeing the strongest symptoms.
Hella said the shackles would be calm and stable when the Chief is around. But now that he's dead, why did they become so malevolent? What's spurring them?
steps.female_content: Hella said the shackles would be calm and stable when the Chief is around. But now that she's dead, why did they become so malevolent? What's spurring them?

steps.content: It can't be a Sinner. It must be something more deeply connected to him...
steps.female_content: It can't be a Sinner. It must be something more deeply connected to her...

steps.content: He wasn't in the mine that time, yet Hecate insisted the shackles were there, and the contamination was indeed shattered from below.
steps.female_content: She wasn't in the mine that time, yet Hecate insisted the shackles were there, and the contamination was indeed shattered from below.

steps.content: Those two kids said there was a powerful bond between the two halves. The shackles used this connection to cross space-time and come to the mine. Does that mean the shackles also have a powerful bond with the Corpus, and that it's still alive?
That makes sense. Their problems arose after we cleared the mine and started heading back. The shelter was also a mess when we arrived. That should be the time things went wrong.
...Was ${PlayerName} killed at that time? After he just defeated that monster? Was it because he was weakened by the battle?
steps.female_content: ...Was ${PlayerName} killed at that time? After she just defeated that monster? Was it because she was weakened by the battle?

steps.content: Who did it?
Rustfire claims the Executive Officers did it. Then how did Rustfire bring the Chief out?
If the culprit is Rustfire, what's their motive? What really happened at that time?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Ha... no, it doesn't matter anymore...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: His death benefited everyone.

Rustfire took up the banner of justice and grew rapidly from a small militia on the brink of annihilation to a force that expelled the Executive Committee and occupied all of West District. Both BR-004 and BR-002 are in their hands now. They've realized their goal.

The gangsters used this chance to whitewash their crimes. They became righteous Rustfire warriors by just shouting a few slogans and throwing on a cloak. Plus, they gained extraordinary powers and became Sinners by just touching the leader. That's a lot better than being a gangster.
As for the Executive Committee...

They haven't necessarily lost yet. They let Rustfire have Syndicate and a couple of Black Rings, but those fools didn't do anything with them. They didn't focus on cultivating Hypercubes, nor did they go hunt down the escaped Corpus.
The first thing they did was to come snatch up the "shackles".

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Ha... Rustfire, take a look at the hoodlums you recruited for your so-called "future." And you wanted Syndicans to rise up and take back their future? Ha...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Disgusting! Absolutely disgusting!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: How is this any different from gangs and mania weapons? There's no difference at all! From now on, a swarm of "Sinners" will terrorize Syndicate. Things will be exactly the same as before!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I might as well kill ${PlayerName} and get rid of the shackles for good. The shackles are a new catalyst for violence that must be eradicated before it harms more people!
Her shadow barges into the main hall, slithering along the wall towards where ${PlayerName} is lying.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: A shadow?! It's that blue-haired kid!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Protect the shackles! She's not here to take ${PlayerName} away, she's here to kill!!!! She wants to kill ${PlayerName}!!

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: I'm sick of you bastards! Look what you did to Syndicate, you...
As she goes in for the kill, she sees ${PlayerName}'s thin, calm and gentle face.
It's a face that's so out of place with Syndicate and all the filth around.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't make stuff up! ${PlayerName} would never abandon us. He'll have an explanation for this for sure!
steps.female_content: Don't make stuff up! ${PlayerName} would never abandon us. She'll have an explanation for this for sure!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel him...
steps.female_content: ...Where's Chief... You said you'd take us to see Chief. The shackles are all messed up. I can't feel her...

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Everyone says they hate violence, but violence has already been ingrained in their souls. The more you want to realize a dream, the more shortcuts you're willing to take. All these years, the fastest shortcut in Syndicate has always been violence.
In her moment of hesitation, something pierces the left side of her belly.

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: What an audacious little tyke... You dare harm our "leader"?

steps.speaker: Crache
steps.content: Ha... What a joke... If you really respected him, return him to the people waiting for him!
steps.female_content: Ha... What a joke... If you really respected her, return her to the people waiting for her!
